why: Preprints report the Cartan-Hadamard conjecture (sharp Euclidean isoperimetric inequality in nonpositively curved manifolds) proved in dimension 5 (Chen-Ghomi-Wang) and, per a later 2026 paper, for all dimensions 3 through 9, extending the previously known cases n=2,3,4.
